results.subject: Maths
results.promptText: In a right-angled triangle, the longest side is called the hypotenuse. The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².
results.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem Educational Diagram</title>
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    }

    .title {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      fill: #1e293b;
    }

    .subtitle {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 400;
      fill: #64748b;
    }

    .label-side {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      fill: #1e293b;
    }

    .formula {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      fill: #2563eb;
    }

    @keyframes pulseSquareA {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.75; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.02); }
    }

    @keyframes pulseSquareB {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.75; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.02); }
    }

    @keyframes pulseSquareC {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.75; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.015); }
    }

    .sq-a {
      transform-origin: 92.5px 232.5px;
      animation: pulseSquareA 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .sq-b {
      transform-origin: 180px 320px;
      animation: pulseSquareB 4s ease-in-out infinite 0.5s;
    }

    .sq-c {
      transform-origin: 217.5px 182.5px;
      animation: pulseSquareC 4s ease-in-out infinite 1s;
    }

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="400" fill="#f8fafc" rx="12"/>

  <!-- Header Section (kept strictly above y=85) -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 35)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="36" height="36" rx="8" fill="#e0e7ff"/>
    <text x="18" y="23" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700" fill="#4f46e5">📐</text>
    <text x="50" y="16" class="title">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
    <text x="50" y="34" class="subtitle">For any right-angled triangle: a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Formula Banner -->

    <rect x="0" y="0" width="150" height="38" rx="8" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#bfdbfe" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="75" y="24" class="formula" text-anchor="middle">a² + b² = c²</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== DIAGRAM GRAPHICS (y > 85) ==================== -->

  <!-- Square on side a (Left vertical side: length 75, from (130,195) to (130,270)) -->
  <g class="sq-a">
    <rect x="55" y="195" width="75" height="75" fill="#3b82f6" fill-opacity="0.16" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" rx="4"/>
    <text x="92.5" y="238" class="label-side" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d4ed8">a²</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Square on side b (Bottom horizontal side: length 100, from (130,270) to (230,270)) -->
  <g class="sq-b">
    <rect x="130" y="270" width="100" height="100" fill="#10b981" fill-opacity="0.16" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" rx="4"/>
    <text x="180" y="325" class="label-side" text-anchor="middle" fill="#047857">b²</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Square on side c (Hypotenuse: length 125, edge coincides with (130,195) -> (230,270)) -->
  <g class="sq-c">
    <polygon points="130,195 230,270 305,170 205,95" fill="#8b5cf6" fill-opacity="0.14" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="217.5" y="188" class="label-side" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9">c²</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main Right-Angled Triangle -->
  <polygon points="130,270 230,270 130,195" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right Angle Symbol -->
  <path d="M 130,252 L 148,252 L 148,270" fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="136" y="258" width="6" height="6" fill="#e2e8f0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Triangle Side Labels -->
  <rect x="103" y="220" width="22" height="22" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1"/>

    <circle cx="-70" cy="30" r="3" fill="#64748b"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="180" height="30" rx="6" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#ddd6fe" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="12" y="19" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#7c3aed">Longest side (Hypotenuse)</text>

    <text x="35" y="24" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#334155">Area of blue square = a²</text>

    <path d="M 15 45 L 25 45" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="35" y="49" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#334155">Area of green square = b²</text>

results.subject: Maths
results.promptText: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

      50% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      100% { r: 110px; stroke-dashoffset: 0; }

results.subject: Physics
results.promptText: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>Series Circuit Educational Diagram</title>
  
  <style>
    @keyframes flow {
      from { stroke-dashoffset: 24; }
      to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    .current-path {
      animation: flow 0.8s linear infinite;
    }
    .component-box {
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    .component-box:hover {
      filter: drop-shadow(0px 0px 6px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6));
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="400" fill="#f8fafc" rx="12" />

  <!-- COMPONENTS -->

  <g class="component-box" transform="translate(420, 120)">
    <rect x="-35" y="-20" width="70" height="40" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" />

results.subject: Chemistry
results.promptText: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.
results.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>States of Matter Diagram for GCSE Chemistry</title>
  <style>
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      20% { transform: translate(1px, -1px); }
      40% { transform: translate(-1px, 1px); }
      60% { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }
      80% { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    @keyframes flow-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(4px, -3px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-3px, 4px); }
      75% { transform: translate(2px, 3px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    @keyframes flow-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(-5px, 2px); }
      50% { transform: translate(3px, -4px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-2px, -3px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    @keyframes fly-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(18px, -14px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-12px, 15px); }
      75% { transform: translate(14px, 10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    @keyframes fly-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(-20px, 12px); }
      50% { transform: translate(15px, -15px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-10px, -12px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    @keyframes fly-3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(12px, 18px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-16px, -10px); }
      75% { transform: translate(10px, -14px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }

    .p-solid { animation: vibrate 0.3s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .p-liquid-1 { animation: flow-1 1.8s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .p-liquid-2 { animation: flow-2 2.1s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .p-gas-1 { animation: fly-1 1.2s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .p-gas-2 { animation: fly-2 1.0s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .p-gas-3 { animation: fly-3 1.4s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }

    .box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 10px; }
    .title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; }
    .subtitle { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #64748b; }
    .state-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; }
    .desc { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; fill: #334155; }
    
    .particle { fill: url(#particleGrad); stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 1.5; }
  </style>

  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="particleGrad" cx="30%" cy="30%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#93c5fd" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2563eb" />
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#0f172a" flood-opacity="0.06"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="400" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Header Section -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 35)">
    <text x="0" y="0" class="title">States of Matter (GCSE Chemistry)</text>
    <text x="0" y="20" class="subtitle">Comparing arrangement, movement, and spacing of particles</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Container Boxes (y: 85 to 375) -->
  
  <!-- 1. SOLID -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 85)" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect width="160" height="270" class="box" />
    <text x="80" y="30" text-anchor="middle" class="state-title">Solid</text>
    <text x="80" y="235" text-anchor="middle" class="desc">Close together</text>
    <text x="80" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="desc">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>

    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular lattice, 16 particles) -->
    <g transform="translate(24, 55)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      <circle cx="45" cy="15" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.4s;" />
      <circle cx="75" cy="15" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="15" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;" />
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle cx="15" cy="45" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      <circle cx="45" cy="45" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.0s;" />
      <circle cx="75" cy="45" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.6s;" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="45" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="15" cy="75" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;" />
      <circle cx="45" cy="75" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="75" cy="75" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.4s;" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="75" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle cx="15" cy="105" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.0s;" />
      <circle cx="45" cy="105" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      <circle cx="75" cy="105" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="105" r="11" class="particle p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.4s;" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 2. LIQUID -->
  <g transform="translate(220, 85)" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect width="160" height="270" class="box" />
    <text x="80" y="30" text-anchor="middle" class="state-title">Liquid</text>
    <text x="80" y="235" text-anchor="middle" class="desc">Close, but random</text>
    <text x="80" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="desc">Move past each other</text>

    <!-- Liquid Particles (Irregular arrangement, mostly touching, 16 particles) -->
    <g transform="translate(22, 55)">
      <circle cx="20" cy="18" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="50" cy="15" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.9s;" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="20" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.4s;" />
      <circle cx="112" cy="25" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      
      <circle cx="15" cy="48" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.6s;" />
      <circle cx="45" cy="45" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      <circle cx="78" cy="48" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.8s;" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="52" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;" />
      
      <circle cx="25" cy="78" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.7s;" />
      <circle cx="55" cy="75" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="82" cy="76" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.9s;" />
      <circle cx="110" cy="80" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.4s;" />
      
      <circle cx="20" cy="105" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      <circle cx="50" cy="108" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;" />
      <circle cx="80" cy="104" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-2" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="107" r="11" class="particle p-liquid-1" style="animation-delay: 0.7s;" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. GAS -->
  <g transform="translate(410, 85)" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect width="160" height="270" class="box" />
    <text x="80" y="30" text-anchor="middle" class="state-title">Gas</text>
    <text x="80" y="235" text-anchor="middle" class="desc">Far apart</text>
    <text x="80" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="desc">Move fast in all directions</text>

    <!-- Gas Particles (Widely spaced, fewer particles to show low density, 10 particles) -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 50)">
      <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="11" class="particle p-gas-1" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      <circle cx="90" cy="25" r="11" class="particle p-gas-2" style="animation-delay: 0.7s;" />
      <circle cx="130" cy="35" r="11" class="particle p-gas-3" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      
      <circle cx="50" cy="65" r="11" class="particle p-gas-3" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;" />
      <circle cx="115" cy="80" r="11" class="particle p-gas-1" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      
      <circle cx="25" cy="100" r="11" class="particle p-gas-2" style="animation-delay: 0.8s;" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="115" r="11" class="particle p-gas-1" style="animation-delay: 0.4s;" />
      
      <circle cx="45" cy="145" r="11" class="particle p-gas-2" style="animation-delay: 0.6s;" />
      <circle cx="120" cy="150" r="11" class="particle p-gas-3" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>
